activation_conditions: User reports current or recent vitamin B6 supplement use with neurological symptoms, or cumulative intake may be excessive.
missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend additional B6; collect exact product, dose, duration and co-supplement sources, and escalate if symptoms are present.
safety_exclusions: Do not diagnose neuropathy or infer causality from symptoms alone.
Do not use the U.S. FNB UL and EFSA UL interchangeably.
Do not treat a UL as a target dose.
professional_escalation_conditions: Tingling, numbness, burning, altered sensation, gait or balance symptoms.
High-dose or prolonged B6 use, multiple products containing B6, or medical treatment.
population_and_context: Adults; EFSA 2023 adult UL 12 mg/day including pregnancy/lactation, versus U.S. FNB UL 100 mg/day reported by NIH ODS. Jurisdiction must be displayed.
dose_constraints: No individualized dose generated by this safety rule; prevent additive exposure and refer for professional assessment.
certainty_and_limitations: Evidence claim is in evidence_review status, not approved. EFSA opinion supports UL derivation; app requires clinician/regulatory review before converting this into a hard threshold.
